about_short_description.short_description: HouseEazy is a real estate platform that buys and sells homes and apartments.

product.name: Real Estate Resale Platform
product.description: A digital platform facilitating the buying and selling of resale residential properties in select Indian cities.

product.name: AI/ML-Powered Property Pricing Algorithm
product.description: A proprietary algorithm that uses machine learning to determine accurate market-aligned prices for resale properties.

identifier.value: Property Listing and Virtual Viewing Tools

product.name: Property Listing and Virtual Viewing Tools
product.description: An online property listing service with virtual reality and 3D walkthrough features for viewing resale homes remotely.

product.name: Legal Due Diligence Service
product.description: A service that conducts comprehensive legal checks on resale properties to ensure clear titles and compliance.

product.name: Home Refurbishment and Quality Check
product.description: A process where resale homes undergo a 50-point quality check and refurbishment before being listed for sale.

product.name: Home Insurance Offering
product.description: Free home insurance coverage provided for all resale homes sold through the platform.
